split_rule: sha256 UTF-8 sequence name ascending; official train only
frame_rule: first image then indices n//3 and 2*n//3 of sorted JPEGs
selection_rule: highest discovery sequence mean object IoU among globally fixed two-action schedules and eta; freeze before validation
readout: 24 fit sequences, three frames each; PCA whitening dim64 and RGB ridge lambda0.1
state: two private64x64 matrices reset each target image; reference source unchanged
feedback: observed patch-mean RGB, full image already encoded; not unseen-pixel prediction
schedule: 2 steps OFF/A/B/ALL, 16 trajectories; oracle uses task labels diagnostic only
selector: 4 candidate RGB probe scores per step; reuse observed selection partition3; extra computation disclosed
evaluation: cosine nearest source token mask transfer; object IoU on16x16 grid; not DAVIS official J&F
target_labels: evaluation only, not adaptation or action selection
stopping_rule: report null/harmful semantic effects; no validation-driven retune or full-model expansion
parent_method_limit: not full inverse JEPA and not streaming TTT; screens this feedback and write rule
